claims.content: To view metadata, size, type, and contents of files/archives without extracting them.

goal.raw_text: To view metadata, size, type, and contents of files/archives without extracting them.

claims.content: User
PeaLauncher graphic wrapper is active and displaying file system objects.
User has selected a file or archive object in PeaLauncher’s window.

User selects a file or archive object in the PeaLauncher interface and initiates inspection via UI navigation or keyboard shortcut (e.g., F1 for help, F3 for search, or other functional keys listed under 'File manager’s keyboard shortcuts').

trigger.raw_text: User selects a file or archive object in the PeaLauncher interface and initiates inspection via UI navigation or keyboard shortcut (e.g., F1 for help, F3 for search, or other functional keys listed under 'File manager’s keyboard shortcuts').

claims.content: User selects a file or archive object in PeaLauncher’s window.
System displays information about the selected object (file or archive) on PeaLauncher’s window.
If Test/Check feature was invoked for this object, system shows direct and inspectional knowledge of progress and results of any ongoing functions of PeaZip on computer system’s objects.
User invokes 'Graphic display of information and currently executed functions’ progress window (PeaLauncher)' to view real-time status of archive operations instead of static file metadata.

User uses keyboard shortcuts (e.g., F3 for recursive search, F8 to browse first item in bookmarks list, F9 to set password/keyfile) to navigate or filter displayed file/archive information without using mouse-driven UI elements.
User toggles between ‘browse mode’ and ‘flat view mode’ via ‘`’ key or F6 to alter how file/archive hierarchy is presented during inspection.
User initiates search within current folder and subfolders using F3, or restricts search to current folder only using Ctrl+F3, to locate specific files/archives for inspection.
If the selected file or archive format is not supported for a specific function (e.g., advanced filters or specific browsing modes), the system will ignore that function.
The PeaLauncher window displays a 'Job successfully completed' status message.
The system presents input file size in bytes (e.g., '6438989 B').
The system presents output file size and compression ratio percentage (e.g., '4438310 B (68%)').
The system displays processing time in milliseconds and throughput speed (e.g., '1328 ms (4848000 B/s)').
A green progress bar visually indicates completion of the operation.
User is presented with 'Explore' and 'Ok' buttons to conclude the inspection session.
